name: push_subscriptions
rowId: SHA-256(user_id + ':' + endpoint), first 32 lowercase hex characters
description: Worker-only Web Push device subscriptions. Never grant Appwrite client SDK permissions; all reads/writes use the authenticated Cloudflare Worker and Appwrite server API key.
notes: Do not store VAPID private keys in this table. VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY is a Cloudflare Worker secret.
Subscription rows are private server data. The Worker verifies the Appwrite JWT and always scopes queries to its authenticated user.
The browser must never receive APPWRITE_API_KEY or VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.
